title: Status page timeline, RCA draft, and action tracker for multi-region capacity spike
creator: Emily Chen
description: Post-incident ticket to consolidate customer-facing communications, finalize the RCA, and track action items after the 2025-02-17 multi-region capacity spike affecting US-WEST and EU-CENTRAL. Goal: produce a single customer-facing update on the status page, complete the internal RCA with root cause analysis and mitigations, and assign concrete follow-ups with owners and due dates. This ticket captures the timeline consolidation, links to artifacts, review notes from PM/comms/legal, and an action tracker for engineering and infra changes.
comments: 2025-02-17 09:12 UTC - Initial triage: elevated token latency and 502 rates in us-west. Pager duty routed to infra-oncall (Ravi). Status page incident created (minor update).

2025-02-17 11:05 UTC - Escalated: autoscale failed to provision burst nodes due to quota check race. Temporary mitigation: increase soft limits and route traffic to eu-central. Status page updated with mitigation note.

2025-02-18 15:30 UTC - Emily Chen opened this consolidated ticket to coordinate RCA + customer comms. Draft RCA posted to Confluence (link below). Asked PM (Laura Morales) and Comms (Jamal Ortiz) to review message.

2025-02-20 10:00 UTC - PM review: ask to clarify customer impact numbers and add affected SKUs. Comms review: prefer phased status page messaging (incident -> root cause -> resolution -> follow-ups). Legal asked for no reference to internal quota names.
2025-02-21 17:45 UTC - Engineering PR for autoscale fix opened (runtime repo). Link below. CI flaky; monitoring added to prevent regression. Assigned follow-ups to infra, autoscale, and ops tagging.
2025-02-24 09:00 UTC - Draft customer-facing status page update prepared, legal/comms approved language with minor edits. Scheduled status page post on 2025-02-25 16:00 UTC after release window.
2025-02-25 14:22 UTC - Final internal RCA review completed. Action items refined and deadlines set. This ticket set to In Review pending sign-off from Head of Reliability.
timeline: 2025-02-17 08:58 UTC - First alert: token latency above SLO (us-west).
2025-02-17 09:10 UTC - 502 errors increase; oncall routes to infra. Initial status page entry created.
2025-02-17 09:28 UTC - Autoscale attempts failed to allocate burst nodes: soft quota check raised race condition.
2025-02-17 09:45 UTC - Traffic routing rule applied: shift 30% of inference traffic to eu-central. Latency improves for routed traffic.
2025-02-17 11:20 UTC - Partial restoration: error rate down from 4.7% to 0.6%.
2025-02-17 13:00 UTC - Incident declared resolved for customer impact, monitoring kept on.
2025-02-18 15:05 UTC - Internal postmortem kickoff and evidence collection.
2025-02-21 08:30 UTC - Root cause identified: race in quota verification + kernel selection fallback triggering elevated tail latency during scale events.
action_items: A1: Patch autoscale quota race (runtime autoscaler) - owner: Ravi Kapoor - due: 2025-02-28 - PR: runtime#482
A2: Instrument quota-check latencies and add alert for failed burst allocations - owner: Priya Singh - due: 2025-03-05
A3: Add canary for kernel-selection fallback path for short sequences to prevent tail latency spikes - owner: Mateo Alvarez - due: 2025-03-10
A4: Update status page templates and post-incident playbook to include throughput/regression metrics - owner: Jamal Ortiz (Comms) - due: 2025-03-02
A5: Run simulated burst load test in preprod to validate autoscaler and routing policy - owner: SRE team - due: 2025-03-12
A6: Customer outreach: send targeted notice to affected customers with incident timeline and mitigations - owner: Laura Morales (PM) - due: 2025-02-25
metrics_snapshot: Peak affected requests: 290k/min, peak 95p latency: 1.8s, error spike to 4.7% (approx 12k failed requests), autoscale failure count: 27 attempts failed during 09:20-09:40 UTC.
next_steps: Finalize customer-facing status page post (Jamal) and publish at scheduled window.
Merge autoscaler patch after green CI and run integration load test.
Close loop with enterprise accounts: assign solutions engineer to follow-up with technical summary and mitigation guidance.
Track action items in weekly reliability sync until all items are marked done.
